brief.text: Modern React photo gallery for the Turkey 2026 trip. Eight photo cards in a responsive grid, each with a real photograph on the front and a personal descriptive caption on the back. Click a card to flip and reveal the description; click again to flip back. Light and dark mode via a toggle in the header; the choice persists across reloads through localStorage and respects the user's system prefers-color-scheme on first visit. Built with Vite and React 18, no extra UI libraries, no external state management.
brief.title: Trip Gallery — Turkey 2026

brief.text: Kaijsas Gallery — a photo gallery for the Turkey 2026 trip. Eight photo cards in a responsive grid; each card flips on click to reveal a personal descriptive caption. Light mode only — no theme toggle. Site header shows the title Kaijsas Gallery with a trip subtitle. Modern React 18 + Vite, no extra UI libraries. Five Cells: C-b21b-15 Header (title + subtitle), C-b21b-16 FlipCard (single photo card with flip state), C-b21b-17 Gallery (responsive grid of 8 cards), C-b21b-18 App (composes Header + Gallery), C-b21b-19 mountApp (React entry point).
brief.title: Kaijsas Gallery — Turkey 2026 (Light Mode)

brief.text: Strengthening C-b21b-16 FlipCard spec: added two new ensures to nail down the dual-face structure of the card (one .flip-card__face--front and one .flip-card__face--back must both render). This is a spec refinement on the existing A-0002/A-0003 work, not a code change — the JSX is identical, only the ensures block above it grew. Re-signing the cell because the file SHA changed.
